records.text: Candace Owens said viewers proposed 301 East 66th Street, a building owned by Mark Epstein, as a potential match for the anonymous witness's description of Erika Kirk's white Upper East Side model-housing building.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Well, lo and behold, a few of you guys sent us a building that could potentially match that very description, a building that was owned by Mark Epstein.

verification.notes: The primary episode directly records Owens presenting 301 East 66th as a viewer-suggested potential match. It verifies the qualified proposal, not that it was the anonymous witness's building.

records.text: Candace Owens cited civil filings and a New York Post account saying apartments at 301 East 66th Street were labeled for models and used to house young women brought from overseas.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Wow, apartments for models. And civil filings allege the condos were used to house young women brought from overseas and provided with living quarters, transportation and other benefits to secure compliance. This photo is also courtesy of Corcoran.

verification.notes: The primary episode directly records Owens quoting the article and cited civil filings. This verifies her citation; the milestone preserves the material as article-based context rather than an identification of Erika's building.
